This is modeled as a stochastic process where each injury event acts as a Poisson arrival, modifying the posterior distribution over player efficiency. The stacked box percentage serves as a deterministic proxy for defensive aggression, mapping to a pressure tensor in GSE’s state space. These primitives form a closed-loop system where injury data feeds into efficiency models, which inform game scripts and vice versa.
